assets.name: figuren-posen
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: school presentation illustrated character sprite sheet. Create exactly one landscape canvas with a regular 3 columns by 2 rows grid of SIX isolated full-body character poses, no visible grid or dividing lines. Uniform flat background hex #F5EBDD throughout. Every figure entirely inside its own equal-sized cell, generous empty margins and separation, feet visible, no cropped hands or heads. TOP LEFT: thoughtful older ancient Greek philosopher, short wavy grey hair, grey beard, white toga and muted olive mantle, hand on chin. TOP CENTER: same identical older philosopher in same outfit, confidently pointing with one hand. TOP RIGHT: same identical philosopher holding a rolled parchment scroll. BOTTOM LEFT: adolescent male student, curly dark hair, terracotta toga, playing a modern game controller, expressive and engaged. BOTTOM CENTER: identical student in same outfit making a friendly helpful open-handed gesture. BOTTOM RIGHT: identical student reading an open book. Style: high quality hand-drawn editorial colored-pencil illustration meets ancient Greek ceramic decoration, dark brown ink outlines, visible pencil texture, muted terracotta and olive palette, expressive faces and elegant simple shapes. No text, no labels, no border, no watermark, not photorealistic. The six poses must remain separated for easy individual use.

assets.name: tugend-szenen
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: school presentation illustrated scene triptych. Create exactly one wide landscape 3:1 canvas with THREE distinct isolated groups of complete full-body figures, evenly spaced in a single horizontal row, regular 3 columns by 1 row layout, no visible grid, no frames, no dividers. Uniform flat background hex #F5EBDD, generous blank space separating all three groups, entire illustrations visible including all feet and hands. Shared style: high quality hand-drawn editorial colored-pencil illustration meets ancient Greek ceramic decoration, dark brown ink outlines, visible pencil texture, muted terracotta and olive colors, white and terracotta Greek tunics/togas, expressive faces. Scene LEFT: a bullying situation between students, one intimidating student crowding a smaller student while a fearful bystander turns their head away, clearly showing avoidance. Scene CENTER: thoughtful measured support, a calm student protects and supports a distressed bullied student with one reassuring hand while signaling and calling for help to a trusted adult, composed body language. Scene RIGHT: a reckless student impulsively rushing headlong into a tense conflict between two students, overconfident uncontrolled forward movement but no explicit violence. Ancient Greek styled adolescent characters, no injuries, no blood, no contact violence. No text, no labels, no symbols, no watermark, not photorealistic.

assets.name: lykeion-hintergrund
assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: 16:9 wide background illustration for a German school presentation on Aristotle. Create a spacious quiet ancient Greek Lyceum colonnade, warm cream-colored stone, a museum-like atmosphere, subtle paper texture. Doric columns arranged along the far left and far right sides framing the image, delicate olive branches in the upper side corners, golden afternoon light, soft shadows and restrained dusty olive accents. Central sixty percent of the canvas must be extremely calm, empty pale cream negative space suitable for large dark brown text overlays; avoid structural details and high contrast in the center. High quality hand-drawn editorial colored-pencil and subtle watercolor style with delicate dark-brown contours where needed, inspired by ancient Greek ceramics, muted cream, terracotta and olive palette. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, elegant and atmospheric. No people, no figures, no statues, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no photographic rendering.
